en: A vintage black-and-white postcard showing a large neoclassical building with arched windows on the lower floor and a balustraded rooftop. The building is set in an open square with some construction or rubble visible in the foreground. There is a Spanish postage stamp affixed in the lower right corner featuring two religious figures. Text at the bottom of the postcard reads 'SANTIAGO. — Palacio Consistorial.'
